_why: Lane A row 5 (2026-11-06): h_mad_assemble_tdd.py --phase review stages the 5e agy spec review.

mutations.name: rv-report-required-dropped
mutations._mechanism: A review with no --codex-report proceeds.

mutations.name: rv-report-empty-dropped
mutations._mechanism: A blank report is reviewed as if it said something.

mutations.name: rv-diff-required-dropped
mutations._mechanism: A review of no files proceeds.

mutations.name: rv-diff-conflict-dropped
mutations._mechanism: --diff-path and --base-ref are both accepted, one silently winning.

mutations.name: rv-base-dash-dropped
mutations._mechanism: A --base-ref starting with '-' reaches git as an option.

mutations.name: rv-base-unreadable-masked
mutations._mechanism: A failing git diff reads as an empty change list.

mutations.name: rv-untracked-dropped
mutations._mechanism: A new, untracked file is missing from the base-ref list.
mutations.find: for name in (changed + fresh).split("\0") if name]

mutations.name: rv-dotdot-dropped
mutations._mechanism: A '..' diff path is accepted.

mutations.name: rv-absolute-dropped
mutations._mechanism: An absolute diff path is accepted.

mutations.name: rv-newline-dropped
mutations._mechanism: A multi-line diff path is accepted.
mutations.find: or any(ch in changed_path for ch in "\n\r\0")):  # M:RV-DIFF-INVALID

mutations.name: rv-dedupe-dropped
mutations._mechanism: A repeated diff path is listed twice.

mutations.name: rv-paths-relative
mutations._mechanism: Diff paths are printed relative, leaving view_file to guess the cwd.
mutations.find: f"- {project_root / name}" for name in ordered

mutations.name: rv-residual-dropped
mutations._mechanism: An unfilled slot reaches the reviewer.

mutations.name: rv-not-applicable-dropped
mutations._mechanism: Counts/test flags are silently dropped on a review.
mutations.find: halt = ("review_option_not_applicable", ", ".join(misapplied)) if misapplied else None  # M:RV-NOT-APPLICABLE

mutations.name: rv-only-option-dropped
mutations._mechanism: --diff-path on a RED is silently dropped.
mutations.find: halt = ("review_only_option", ", ".join(stray)) if stray else None  # M:RV-ONLY-OPTION

mutations.name: rv-dispatch-bypassed

mutations.name: rv-block-bypassed
mutations._mechanism: A review prints the implementer's block, with its pytest line.

mutations.name: rv-agent-codex-default
mutations._mechanism: A review defaults to codex.
